ctx.x: How, how strong is the union in, in, in setting prices, here's salaries, in setting times for them to play, this sort of thing?

We've been fortunate, the president of the union happens to be a very fine musician who plays here quite frequently. In fact, Lewis Gattrell's band will be playing tomorrow night. Uh, even very cooperative. We adhere to all union regulations, we pay them on union scale, and work union hours.

But there's something interesting that you do over here, it's sort of hard to describe. You, you don't charge anything to get in, but you sort of pass the kitty. Can, can you actually make enough on this to pay the musicians? What about it, Sandra? Sometimes. Um, Saturday nights we usually do. And on Friday nights, well, the past two weeks have been rather slow, but our first two months here we've been able to meet expenses. Um, we thought about charging an admission, but there are a lot of problems involved once…
